purpose: PropBetEdge Boxing database - the ONE Boxing Supabase project (owner topology 2026-10-02). Rebuilt from the migration chain and re-collected sources; never cloned.
secrets: DB password in D:\Workers\secrets oxing-production-db.env (outside git). API keys are fetched at use time, never stored in the repo. Worker internal tokens: D:\Workers\secrets oxing-<worker>-production-internal-token.

workers.boxing-gateway-production: workers/boxing-gateway --env production; workers.dev; read-only; bearer token
workers.boxing-rankings-production: workers/boxing-rankings --env production; cron 20th 14:25/35/45/55Z; TITLES_INGEST_ENABLED gates writes
workers.boxing-commissions-production: workers/boxing-commissions --env production; cron 40 11 * * *; COMMISSION_INGEST_ENABLED gates writes
workers.boxing-odds-production: workers/boxing-odds --env production; cron */15; ODDS_CAPTURE_ENABLED gates capture

rule: No new billable resource without explicit owner cost approval (CLAUDE.md).
